meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 装上后,当要求移除死代码时,Claude会扫描项目找出未使用的代码,逐项用LSP确认,然后并行派多个子代理分批删除,每批单独提交,最后跑类型检查、测试和构建验证。
howto.when: 当用户说出“remove dead code”、“cleanup”等触发词,或要求清理项目中未使用的代码时触发。

say.text: 把项目里未使用的代码都删掉
say.note: Claude会启动扫描并并行删除

say.text: 只清理src目录下的死代码
say.note: 扫描范围会限定在这个目录

say.text: 找出未使用的导出符号并移除
say.note: 这些符号会被验证后删除

howto.what_en: When asked to remove dead code, Claude scans the project for unused code, verifies each item with LSP, batches them, and parallel agents delete them in separate atomic commits, then runs typecheck, tests, and build.
howto.when_en: When user says 'remove dead code', 'cleanup', or asks to clean unused code from the project.

say_en.text: Remove all unused code from the project.
say_en.note: Claude scans and removes in parallel.

say_en.text: Clean up dead code only in src directory.
Find and remove unused exported symbols.
